title: Person: Mr Casey
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Casey

anchor.prefix:
. Were we to desert him at the bidding of the English people?

 —He was no longer worthy to lead, said Dante. He was a public sinner.

 —We are all sinners and black sinners, said
anchor.suffix:
coldly.

 —Woe be to the man by whom the scandal cometh! said Mrs Riordan. It would be better for him that a millstone were tied about his neck and that he were cast into the dept
